name: Family Afternoon in Front of the TV
title: 1980s Family Watching TV Photo Prompt for ChatGPT
description: Use this 1980s family watching tv photo prompt to put your group on a floral sofa by a boxy CRT set. Works in ChatGPT or Gemini with your own photo.
prompt: Using the uploaded photo(s), place every person shown into a 1980s living room on a weekday afternoon, gathered on a brown-and-orange floral sofa watching a boxy wood-grain CRT television with a rabbit-ear antenna. Keep each person's face, facial features, skin tone, age and body proportions exactly recognisable; do not beautify, slim or smooth anyone, and do not add or remove people. Give adults feathered or permed hair, knit cardigans, polo shirts and high-waisted slacks; children wear striped T-shirts and corduroy. Add a shag rug, a crocheted doily on top of the TV, a bowl of popcorn and soft sun slanting through net curtains. Poses are relaxed, some glancing back at the camera. Shot on 35mm consumer colour negative film: warm yellow cast, mild grain, faded shadows, slight vignette, a small crease in the print. The screen shows only a blurred glow. No modern devices, flat screens, logos or readable text; a real family snapshot, not a filter or illustration.
intro: Almost every family album from the decade has a picture like this: everyone squeezed onto one sofa, half watching the set, half watching whoever holds the camera. Recreating it with your own family turns an ordinary group photo into something that feels like a found print from a relative's shoebox, which is why it lands so well in family chats.
creates: The finished image shows your group on a patterned brown-and-orange sofa in a cosy living room, turned toward a chunky wood-grain television with rabbit ears. Afternoon light falls through net curtains onto a shag rug and a bowl of popcorn. Everyone keeps their own face but wears cardigans, polos and corduroy. The colours lean warm and yellow, shadows are faded, and the print has a soft crease.
works: The line "place every person shown" plus "do not add or remove people" stops the model from dropping or inventing family members. "Do not beautify, slim or smooth anyone" keeps faces honest. Props like "a crocheted doily on top of the TV" make the room specific instead of generic retro. "The screen shows only a blurred glow" avoids fake broadcast text, and "not a filter or illustration" pushes toward a real photographic look.
tips: Upload a group photo where every face is clearly visible and similar in size; tiny or turned-away faces are the ones most likely to drift.
If one person changes, reply with that person's position, for example "the man on the left must keep his exact face from the upload", and regenerate.
For a different mood, swap the afternoon sun for lamplight at night, or replace the popcorn with dinner plates on TV trays.
suits: Families recreating a shared memory, siblings making a gift for parents, or anyone posting a throwback-style group picture to a family chat, a reunion album or an anniversary post.
personalize: Change the sofa pattern, the snack on the table and each person's clothing to match what your own household would have had.

name: Old Passport and ID Picture
title: 1980s Passport Photo Prompt for ChatGPT & Gemini
description: Try this 1980s passport photo prompt to turn your picture into a straight-on ID shot with plain backdrop and faded colour. Works in ChatGPT and Gemini.
prompt: Using my uploaded photo, recreate me as a 1980s passport or ID photograph. Keep my face, facial features, skin tone, age, hairline and head shape exactly as they are; no beautification, no skin smoothing, no reshaping. Lighting is flat and frontal from a single flash, leaving a faint shadow behind the head. Render it as a small photo-booth style print with slightly muted colour, a mild magenta shift, fine grain and a tiny scuff at one edge. No official stamps, seals or readable text, no modern clothing, no logos; not a painting, sketch or filter.
intro: An old ID picture is the least glamorous photo anyone owns, and that is exactly the charm. Seeing yourself stiff, straight-on and slightly faded, as if the photo came out of a drawer of expired documents, is funny and oddly convincing. It is also one of the easiest looks for the model to get right, because the pose is simple.
creates: You get a tight head-and-shoulders portrait facing the camera squarely with a neutral expression, set against a flat pale-blue or off-white wall. Your hair is neatly cut in a period style and you wear a dark blazer and wide collar or a buttoned blouse. Flat flash leaves a soft shadow behind your head, and the small print has muted, slightly magenta colour, fine grain and a worn edge.
works: "Head and upper shoulders straight-on" and "eyes level with the lens" lock the framing that makes an ID photo read instantly. The identity line names "hairline and head shape", which matter more than usual in such a tight crop. "A mild magenta shift" and "a tiny scuff at one edge" give believable ageing. "No official stamps, seals or readable text" keeps the model from inventing documents, and "not a painting, sketch or filter" keeps it photographic.
tips: Upload a front-facing photo with neutral expression and even light; a smiling or angled selfie makes the model rebuild more of your face and raises drift.
If your features soften or change, add "match the uploaded face pixel for pixel in proportions" and ask for a regeneration rather than editing the result.
Swap the pale-blue backdrop for off-white or grey, or ask for a strip of four photo-booth frames for a playful variation.
suits: Anyone joining the trend who wants a deadpan, low-effort result, people making funny profile pictures, and friends comparing their serious old ID versions side by side in a group chat or story.
personalize: Change the clothing line to what you would really have worn for an official photo and pick the backdrop colour you remember.
